title: Employer source group
description: One file per employer under _meta/sources/. Employers are the unit of update checking: the state and the county publishers move at unrelated rates (and two counties overwrite files in place), so a single manifest would make every employer's drift one employer's problem. Adapted from oregon-counties' schema; validated in CI via plugins.extra_schema_checks.

group.description: Must equal the filename without .yml, and the employer slug without any -county suffix (state | multnomah | ...)

crawl.description: THE ROBOTS/ACCESS DETERMINATION FOR THIS EMPLOYER, recorded so it is reviewable in a PR rather than buried in a fetcher. `decision` records what was concluded and `basis` records why, per source host. The survey measured one host (Yamhill) refusing and then serving the same honest UA hours apart — intermittent blocking is a recorded fact here, not a standing verdict.

decision.description: proceed: ingest. excluded: deliberately not ingested. unavailable: the host refused an honestly-identified agent at the HTTP layer, so there is nothing to decide — we do not retry disguised as a browser.

ai_block.description: true when robots.txt names an AI crawler and gives it Disallow: /

upstream_signal.description: Human note: what upstream mechanism announces a change here, and how often it actually moves. For the state, the SharePoint list is enumerable; for counties this is usually 're-fetch the index, diff the link set, re-hash the documents' — mandatory where filenames are undated and overwritten in place (Lane, Marion).

family.description: Determines the subdirectory, and therefore the doc_type (cba -> collective_bargaining_agreement, loa -> letter_of_agreement). LOAs bound into a CBA PDF stay family: cba; only separately-published letters are loa.

sha256.description: Content hash as corpus-detect-changes computes it on a fresh fetch — NOT the document's source_sha256, which hashes our extractor's output. May be empty ONLY before the first refresh_source_hashes run.

union.description: The signatory union/association as the employer's index names it

term.description: Contract term as YYYY-YYYY. OMIT when the index does not state it and the document has not been opened yet (Clackamas shows no terms; Lane and Marion serve undated files) — an inferred term is a fabrication.
